toll_collector.text: Toll office retired. Tolls were abolished on 17 December 2018. I collect dad jokes now, and you owe me one.
The Severn Bridge opened in 1966. Its deck is shaped like an aeroplane wing, so the wind slides over it instead of shoving. That was a brand new idea then.

then.text: Another cuppa? Careful on the bridge. Off you go.

else.text: It is a long way across: the main span is 988 metres. Here is a cuppa for the road. It is free, I am out of toll booths to hide it in.

toll_painter.text: They say a bridge painter's work is never done. By the time I reach the Welsh end, the English end needs another coat.
